svg.title: Traction slide: from a table to a trend
svg.desc: Mobile version. Before: a KPI table with six metrics over four quarters and no conclusion. After: the headline ARR grew 12x in four quarters, 24 stores are live today, and a four-bar chart of ARR from 18 to 212 thousand dollars, the last bar highlighted. Fictional company Kelvadore Foods.
